# Vendored Sonora crates

`music` and `storage` are vendored from [Sonora](https://github.com/sonorahq/sonora),
licensed GPL-3.0-or-later (see [COPYING](COPYING)).

Cauce's modifications: a configurable sign-in return page, only the local and Subsonic
providers, and Cauce's own identity (cache and data folders, user agents and scrobbling
client). Copyright and licence notices are unchanged.
